body:
the Decode thread has me spiraling again and i need company 😭

ok here's your challenge: open it and find the clue where Taylor filmed herself pressing an elevator button marked 18 in a tiny instagram video back in august 2014. fourteen days later, on august 18th, she announced 1989 and premiered 'shake it off.' the number WAS the announcement. she told us the exact date and we just... watched a button.

and that's only ONE. the thread lays out pair after pair in order — the glitchy snake clips before reputation, the hidden 'APRIL NINTH' capitals buried in the fearless (taylor's version) letter, the orange door she walked out of at the final eras tour show that became the whole showgirl era.

go find the one you'd never clocked before, then come back and tell me which clue actually made you gasp 👀

open it → longlivets.com/?lens=hidden-clues&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
